profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a skilled software engineer with a hunger for learning new skills and acquiring more knowledge in my field. To that end, I have chosen to pursue a Masters Degree in Computer Science at Georgia Tech while working full time. With 2 years of experience as a full stack developer, I'm interested in diving deeper into full stack development as well as exploring machine learning related opportunities. Feel free to contact me through LinkedIn or direct email at nnelson314@gmail.com

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
° Integrated Google ReCAPTCHA into the iCIMS Onboard portal
° Built REST APIs for third parties to build their own onboarding solutions on top of iCIMS backend
° Designed and implemented APIs for iCIMS in-house web forms solution
° Migrated legacy JSP code to React SPA

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
º Refactored iCIMS Onboard to have a Mobile Responsive UI
º Built feature that allows employers to rehire candidates with iCIMS Recruit
º Fixing bugs related to customer support cases
º Writing and fixing automation tests

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
º Built automation tool for viewing logs from SumoLogic using Springboot, SQL, jQuery, HTML/CSS. Currently used by agile teams 
º Optimized aforementioned automation tool’s performance using parallel programming design patterns
º Built a Java client for the iCIMS Streaming API
º Fixed bugs in production code

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
º Prototyped approach for connecting to SDN controller using Open vSwitch and VirtualBox 
º Wrote bash scripts to automate tasks on the command line
º Troubleshooted Android Open Source Project build issues

positions.title: Freelance Android Developer
positions.description:
º Worked as part of a team to build an Android app for PostYourBook
º Connected backend data to the user interface
º Learned how to create REST APIs to interact with other applications
º Built UI based on provided wireframes
